site.name: Kit Carson Union Pacific Railroad Depot (Museum)
overview: The Kit Carson Union Pacific Railroad Depot is a surviving 1904 wood-frame combination depot in Kit Carson, Colorado, now used as a museum.

timeline.text: The depot was constructed as a Union Pacific standard-plan combination depot.

moreHistory: History Colorado identifies the building as a well-preserved example of a Union Pacific standard-plan combination depot. Its survival provides a tangible link to the railroad era that shaped Kit Carson and the surrounding eastern plains.
